summary: Defines encryption transforms for ESP and IKEv2 in IPsec, based on the GOST R 34.12-2015 block ciphers Magma and Kuznyechik in Multilinear Galois Mode with external rekeying. It helps implementations wanting GOST support and does not imply IETF endorsement. It is informational.

eli5.summary: This lets private network tunnels use Russian standard scrambling methods.
